blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Deer Lake. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Deer Lake, Burnaby: 13 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 17 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Deer Lake rose from 12 in June to 13 in September (+8.3%), and 3 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.8% of Burnaby’s 458 houses listed.

blocks.text: Deer Lake home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

5 houses sold in Deer Lake with a median price of $2,900,000, taking a median of 24 days to sell at 93.0% of the last list price; 20% sold above list. They had a median $717 per square foot, a median year built of 1990 and a median lot of 13,090 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Deer Lake?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 houses listed in Deer Lake. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Deer Lake a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Deer Lake had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Deer Lake from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses sold in Deer Lake over those 4 months, out of 199 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Deer Lake?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Deer Lake sell for?
faq.a: 5 houses sold in Deer Lake between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,900,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Deer Lake?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 93.0% of the last list price (20% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
